import Foundation
func checksum(_ data: Data) -> UInt64 {
    let bytes = data.span
    var result: UInt64 = 0
    for index in bytes.indices { result &+= UInt64(bytes[index]) }
    return result
}
precondition(checksum(Data()) == 0)
precondition(checksum(Data([0, 1, 127, 128, 255])) == 511)
precondition(checksum(Data(repeating: 171, count: 65536)) == 11206656)
print("Data.span strict-memory-safety checks passed")
